    std::string s;
    std::cin >> s;

    int result = 0;
    char previous = '.';
    bool oddRunLength = true;

    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        char current = s[i];
        if (current == previous) {
            oddRunLength = !oddRunLength;
        } else {
            if (!oddRunLength) {
                result++;
            }
            previous = current;
            oddRunLength = true;
        }
    }

    if (!oddRunLength) {
        result++;
    }
    std::cout << result << std::endl;

    return 0;
}
